objective: Measure the isolated CPU cost of the exact row-anchor plus 4-bit ratio scale layout on a Qwen3.8-27B MLP projection before integrating it with a compressed direct weight decoder

scope.claim_boundary: aligned two-bit weight compute image isolates scale-layout overhead; this is not a base-3 direct-decode or end-to-end token benchmark

candidate.row_anchors: one FP16 factor per output row
candidate.ratio_codebook: one 16-entry FP16 table per tensor with exact zero at entry zero
candidate.numeric_contract: FP32 multiplication of the two stored FP16 factors
candidate.kernel: single-thread AVX2 plus F16C plus FMA aligned-two-bit A8 GEMV with scale reconstruction fused before each row

control.kernel: same aligned-two-bit AVX2 A8 GEMV with one materialized FP16 scale per group
control.difference: the product of the two candidate FP16 factors is rounded once more to FP16 for the control API
control.purpose: performance control only; candidate-vs-scalar candidate establishes the exact candidate numeric contract

measurement.cpu_affinity: one frozen physical core supplied by the watcher

promotion_rules: run only if the complete 666-tensor row-scale reconstruction and storage gate passes
a pass authorizes a compressed-code fused kernel experiment but proves neither base-3 direct speed nor model quality
CUTE, MATH, code, MMLU-type, WikiText, and end-to-end paired throughput remain mandatory for any exported model
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
no scientific breakthrough claim can come from this isolated microkernel
